title: Task 6: Build a Context-Aware Chat Assistant with Memory
summary: This lesson guides learners through building a simple AI chat assistant that remembers previous messages and uses conversation history as context. Students will load a language model, maintain conversation memory, build context for each prompt, and run a continuous chat loop.

sections.text: Step 1 states that the user must load a language model using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers. This fulfills the objective to load an LLM and satisfies the required feature to load a language model.

Step 2 states that the system must store conversation history, including user messages and AI responses. This allows the AI to maintain a conversation instead of responding to each message independently.
Step 3: Build Context and Run Chat Loop

Step 3 states that the user must build context for each prompt by combining previous conversation history, adding the new user question, and sending everything as context to the model. The user runs a continuous chat loop where they can ask multiple questions, such as stating 'My name is Ahmed.' and asking 'What is my name?', to observe how memory affects the model's responses.

learning_objectives: Load an LLM using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers
Build a chat loop where the user can ask multiple questions and store conversation history
Inject the previous conversation as context in each new prompt and observe how memory affects model responses

vocabulary.definition: An AI model loaded using a Python library such as Hugging Face Transformers.
Stored user messages and AI responses used to maintain a conversation.
Combined previous conversation history and the new user question sent to the model.
